item.title: FedEx adds new US-China cargo flights ahead of Xi-Trump meeting
item.description: American delivery giant FedEx is expanding its trans-Pacific services between China and the United States, adding four weekly flights by cargo aircraft just days ahead of an expected meeting between President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen. The Memphis-based courier said on Monday that Boeing 777 cargo planes would link Shanghai and Guangzhou with the US, providing additional capacity for advanced manufacturing, semiconductor production, artificial intelligence...

item.title: China puts yuan within easier reach of Africa, but adoption faces major hurdles: report
item.description: China is making it easier for African countries to pay for Chinese-led infrastructure projects in yuan, but weak banking rules, high debt levels and historical dependence on the US dollar and euro continue to limit broader adoption of the currency, an Egypt-based political scientist said in an analysis released on Monday. Beijing had been expanding its financial influence across Africa by integrating Standard Bank, the continent’s largest lender by assets, into China’s Cross-Border Interbank...

item.title: Singapore adds lustre to bullion hub with gold vault service for central banks
item.description: Singapore on Tuesday launched a gold storage service for foreign central banks and other financial institutions, as it seeks to bolster its position as a major precious metals trading hub. The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) said the facility, housed in the city state’s national currency vault, could store 500 tonnes of gold but could expand that as demand grows. item.title: Elon Musk and Michael Miebach to join Trump at Apec in Shenzhen. What about Jensen Huang?
item.description: Top US business leaders, including Tesla and SpaceX chief Elon Musk and Mastercard’s Michael Miebach, are expected to join Donald Trump’s delegation to China for next week’s Apec summit, the South China Morning Post understands. Nvidia chief Jensen Huang had been in talks to join, but his participation is now in doubt amid a controversy that has rocked his company and the wider tech industry. item.title: Minibus driver arrested in Hong Kong for alleged drug driving while carrying passengers
item.description: A minibus driver has been arrested in Hong Kong on suspicion of driving under the influence of drugs while carrying passengers, after he tested positive for methamphetamine during a police interception.
